author: Samsung
description:
Keeping students engaged throughout a lesson requires teachers to balance instruction, interaction and individual learning needs. Samsung AI Assistant is a built-in app for compatible Samsung Interactive Displays that helps educators support every stage of a lesson — from instruction to assessment.

Watch how features like Live Transcript, Circle to Search and AI Quiz help make lessons more accessible, bring relevant learning resources into the classroom and support student understanding while keeping lessons flowing.

Learn more about Samsung display solutions: http://smsng.co/B2Bsolutions

title: Interactive Display: Make Every Lesson More Engaging with AI Assistant | Samsung
